§6Weapon Steel§f

§aSteel forged with coker gas and flux - your gateway to better guns and ammo!§f

Weapon Steel is a steel alloy made by further refining regular steel in the §bRotary Furnace§f using Coker Gas and Flux. It is the next tier of weapons-grade alloy after gunmetal.

§6Production§f (Rotary Furnace):
§b•§f §e1×§f Steel Ingot + §e2×§f Flux + §e100mB§f Coker Gas → §e1×§f Weapon Steel Ingot.

§6Uses§f:
§b•§f Higher-tier ammunition casings for advanced rounds.
§b•§f Weapon parts like barrels and receivers for advanced firearms.
§b•§f Alternative recipe for PWR Neutron Reflectors (before oil 3): §e2×§f Cast Steel Plate + §e16×§f Weapon Steel Plate → §e4×§f PWR Neutron Reflector.

§ePS:§f Weapon Steel needs §bCoker Gas§f, so set up your Coker Unit first. Each ingot consumes §e100mB§f - a single batch of Aromatic Hydrocarbons (§e1,700mB§f) yields §e170mB§f Coker Gas, enough for §e1.7§f ingots. Scale up your coker for mass production!
